exposure: caesarean section in second stage of labor
cohort: 100 women undergoing caesarean section at full cervical dilation, >37 weeks gestation with a singleton fetus in cephalic presentation, out of a total of 2400 caesarean sections (1700 emergency and 700 elective).
finding: Women who delivered by cesarean section in the second stage of labor had a higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage (12%), operative morbidity (wound infection 8%, fever 17%), prolonged hospital stay (6.6 days), and neonatal complications (NICU admission 6%, nursery admission 12%, jaundice 14%, 2 neonatal deaths).
